mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede corporate earnings declines and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises above 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, which typically leads to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) during a late-cycle expansion signals weakening manufacturing activity, which typically precedes a slowdown in economic growth and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong residential construction activity, which typically boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly reading of CPIAUCSL above 265.0 signals persistent inflation, which typically triggers a hawkish monetary policy response and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 265.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 265.0) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL > 265.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 6.0%), a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 6.0% and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
